propositions: Rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped in practice; inline provider checks hardcode anthropic string matching, refusing base_url/api_key despite documentation claiming they work
Bedrock-hosted Anthropic LLMs are inaccessible; clients need a native Bedrock path, not just an OpenAI-compatible gateway proxy that loses caching and structured output
A provider-agnostic seam using pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook allows Anthropic and Bedrock as first-class providers and everything else through a best-effort OpenAI-compatible builder
ModelProfile capability flags from pydantic-ai replace hardcoded provider-name string matching; Bedrock Anthropic receives a profile override reflecting its differing cache and capability semantics
Signed verdict sidecars must record provider, model, endpoint host, and support tier so consumers distinguish first-class from best-effort attestations
Retry, timeout, and caching guarantees differ between direct-Anthropic (httpx transport) and Bedrock (botocore); this is a documented limitation, not hidden
